blurb: The Hotchkiss Golf Course was designed in 1924 by Seth Raynor and circles the Hotchkiss School campus. It is just over 3,000 yards with a par of 35, providing challenging play. The course offers views of Lake Wononscopomuc and the Berkshire-Taconic mountains.
